title: The 6 Best Pull-Up Bars Under $80
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for pull-up bars under $80, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pull-up bars under $80 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: ProsourceFit Multi-Grip Chin-Up/Pull-Up Bar
products.blurb: Key specs: 12 grip positions, Heavy-gauge steel frame, 300-pound rated capacity.
strengths: 300-pound rating with a wider 36-inch doorway fit than budget bars
Limited lifetime warranty is rare at this price
limitations: Longer bar protrudes further into the doorway walkway
Still a doorway leverage mount, less rigid than a bolted wall bar
Foam grips are firmer than some competitors, less comfortable on long sets

products.name: Perfect Fitness Multi-Gym Doorway Pull Up Bar
products.blurb: Key specs: 3 padded grip positions, Converts to a floor unit for push-ups, dips, sit-ups, 300-pound rated capacity.
strengths: Replaces multiple pieces of home gym equipment with one purchase
Rotating padded handles are noticeably more comfortable than fixed grips
Well within budget with room to spare for accessories
limitations: Fewer grip positions than the ProsourceFit at a similar price
6-inch trim depth requirement rules out some thinner door casings
Bulkier to store than a bar-only design
features: Converts to a floor unit for push-ups, dips, sit-ups

products.name: Stamina Doorway Pull-Up Bar Trainer
products.blurb: Key specs: 12 grip options, Thick non-slip foam grips, 250-pound rated capacity.
strengths: Extra-thick padding is noticeably easier on the hands over long sets
12 grip options at a mid-range price
limitations: 250-pound capacity is lower than the 300-pound bars in this list
Frame flexes slightly more than heavier-gauge steel competitors
Fewer total ratings than the market leaders

products.name: Ultimate Body Press Wall Mount Pull Up Bar
products.blurb: Key specs: Bolts to 16 or 24-inch on-center wall studs, Reversible risers for two mounting depths, Rated well above 300 pounds when installed correctly.
strengths: Meaningfully more rigid and higher-rated than any doorway bar
limitations: Requires accessible wall studs and a permanent installation
features: Bolts to 16 or 24-inch on-center wall studs
Reversible risers for two mounting depths
Rated well above 300 pounds when installed correctly

products.name: Gorilla Gym Gym1 Pull Up Bar Core Unit
products.blurb: Key specs: Telescopic no-assembly doorway mount, 300-pound rated capacity, Compatible with an extender and gymnastic rings accessories.
strengths: Telescopic design installs with genuinely zero assembly
Compatible accessories (extender, rings) add long-term versatility
300-pound rating comfortably within this budget tier
limitations: Fewer total ratings than the more established brands in this list
Accessories add to the total cost if purchased separately
Only useful in doorways with proper interior-style trim
features: Compatible with an extender and gymnastic rings accessories
